extracted.name: Vegan Cornbread Muffins
extracted.description: These are probably one of my favorite hiking treats. These guys are super easy to fire up in the morning before you set off.
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, corn meal, sugar, salt, and baking powder
Stir in oat milk and canola oil
Lightly spray a 3x4 muffin tin with oil
Evenly spoon out the batter into the muffin tin
Bake for 20-25 minutes. Use a toothpick to test the muffins. Insert into the center of a few of them and make sure it comes out cleanly
